source.event: every nonzero provider-reported daily Total flow
source.availability: flow dated d is usable at 00:00 UTC on d+1

actions.continuation: direction equals sign of reported ETF Total flow
actions.fade: direction is opposite sign of reported ETF Total flow
trigger_for_each_direction: after source availability, observe completed five-minute bars only
require at least one completed five-minute candle whose close-open sign is against the candidate action direction
from that first pullback candle track the causal pullback extreme
trigger on the first later completed five-minute candle that closes in the candidate direction and beyond the immediately preceding completed five-minute high for a long or low for a short
trigger must occur before the next ETF-flow publication
actions.execution: first strictly later observable one-minute Bybit trade open

risk_and_exit.atr: twenty completed five-minute true ranges available before trigger completion
risk_and_exit.protected_origin: minimum low from first pullback candle through trigger for long; maximum high for short
risk_and_exit.hard_stop: protected origin plus an adverse 0.25 ATR20 buffer
risk_and_exit.structural_exit: first completed five-minute close across the protected origin, executed after 500 ms at the first strictly later one-minute open
risk_and_exit.source_state_exit: first later ETF publication whose Total sign differs from the entry event sign, executed after 500 ms at the first strictly later one-minute open

source_prior_only: component concentration and IBIT/GBTC signed shares
market_causal: one-hour, four-hour and twenty-four-hour trade returns
mark-index basis and premium index levels plus prior-only normalization
one-hour, four-hour and twenty-four-hour open-interest change
source-to-trigger signed price progress and trigger latency
action: direction times each directional market-state feature

online_ml.training_target: resolved after-cost action R at 18 bp
online_ml.refit_schedule: first UTC day of every month
online_ml.training_set: all action labels fully resolved before refit timestamp
online_ml.decision: among causally triggered continuation and fade candidates while the slot is free, choose the highest predicted 18-bp R only when it is strictly above zero; same-time ties choose the higher prediction and then continuation

baselines: always take continuation trigger when slot is free
always take fade trigger when slot is free

account.funding: actual signed Bybit funding at recorded timestamp using causally observed market-price proxy
account.daily_nav: cash plus adverse-cost liquidation value of any open position

winner_dependence.diagnostic: remove the top ten percent of positive completed trades by PnL event identity and rebuild source-event candidates, online refits and global-slot account path from scratch

promotion_gate: continuous 18-bp and 24-bp account paths positive, at least 40 completed trades, PF above one, no forced liquidation, and exact winner-deletion reroute positive before risk/leverage search
prohibited_rescue: model or zero-threshold search after outcomes
risk or leverage search before base-alpha promotion
